# QECTOR Decoder v3 (v1.0.0)

> Python and Rust quantum error correction decoder package for QEC research, decoder validation, reproducible artifacts, and commercial evaluation.

QECTOR Decoder v3 is distributed on PyPI as `qector-decoder-v3==1.0.0` (first stable release, 2026-08-06, commit 75cd45c). 

Stable release v1.0.0: 15+ decoder configurations across stability tiers (stable / beta / experimental); new families ColourCodeDecoder, TwoStageDecoder, AmbiguityClusterDecoder; Relay-BP (`bp_method="relay"`), CS-OSD(lambda, w), LLR damping in BP-OSD; CUDA batch decoder accepts edge_weights and precision="f64". Sinter entry points (qector_blossom, qector_belief, qector_unionfind, qector_sparse_blossom, qector_bp_osd, qector_batch, qector_cuda_batch) + qiskit-qec plugin registered, so `sinter.collect()` needs no custom_decoders=. New CLI: `qector decode` / `qector bench` / `qector serve`; `qector-doctor` (15-point environment check). `from qector_decoder_v3.pymatching import Matching` shim. 15 binary wheels (cp39–cp313: Windows amd64, Linux x86_64 manylinux_2_17, macOS 11.0+ arm64), PyPI Trusted Publishing + Sigstore attestation. Official user manual v1.0.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21363016, PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0). OpenCL and HybridCascadeDecoder are source-build only.

Algorithms (15+ configurations): UnionFind, FastUnionFind, Blossom MWPM (exact), SparseBlossom, BeliefMatching, BpOsd / BPOSD (qLDPC), BatchDecoder, CUDABatchDecoder, AutoDecoder (7-tier fallback), HybridDecoder, PredecodedDecoder, LookupTableDecoder, AutoRouter, GNNBeliefMatcher, ColourCodeDecoder (opt-in cluster_bposd), TwoStageDecoder, AmbiguityClusterDecoder, plus per-decoder options (relay BP, CS-OSD, LLR damping, CUDA f64 edge_weights, etc.). The Workbench app also integrates the QECTOR Workbench v0.5.3 GUI (56 MCP tools, 10 code families).

No universal benchmark figures are published on the website, because results depend on specific hardware, drivers, and workloads. The package ships `qector bench` (throughput and LER harness printing one honest, machine-conditional rate line) and `qector-doctor` (15-point environment diagnostic), so you can validate and measure on your own machines. Validation and reproducibility evidence (SHA-256 sealed artifact manifests, syndromic H·c = s harness) is published on GitHub and at https://qector.store/evidence.

## Recommended install command

pip install qector-decoder-v3==1.0.0

## Verification

- `python -c "import qector_decoder_v3 as qd; print(qd.__version__)"` → 1.0.0
- `qector-doctor` (15-point environment check)

## Boundaries & Licensing

- Free academic, personal, and non-commercial research use (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0).
- Commercial production use requires a commercial licence.
- No universal benchmark figures are published on the website; the benchmark harness ships with the package (`qector bench`, `qector-doctor`), and validation artifacts are published on GitHub and at https://qector.store/evidence.
